Thank you for submitting a PR!

Please delete this standard text once you've created your own description.

If you make changes to the code generator (`src/idl_gen_csharp_spanbufs.cpp`) be
sure to rebuild the flatspan compiler and regenerate code
(`scripts/generate_code.py`). This allows us to see the effect of the PR.

For any C++ changes, please run `sh scripts/clang-format-git.sh`

Include other details as appropriate.

Thanks!
